name: Torn Bear Pelts
summary: You bring torn bear pelts to someone who plans to have them sewn into plush toys. Tickets are offered as payment.

sections.title: A New Use
sections.body: The recipient plans to have the bear pelts sewn into plush toys, with stuffing and paint. They offer you tickets as payment.

faq.q: What are the bear pelts for?
faq.answer: They are intended to be sewn into plush toys with stuffing and paint.

faq.q: What do I get for the pelts?
faq.answer: The recipient offers you tickets as payment.
The recipient says someone will sew the pelts into plush toys.

attribution: In-game quest text: Torn Bear Pelts
